'''Exo''' was a legendary [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that may or may not have existed. The philosopher [[Deamos Na-Coth]] believed in the existence of the planet, and founded a series of expeditions known as [[The Cabal (expedition)|The Cabal]] to search beyond the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] to find the planet.
